stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 17 & 18 - the field is on notice

stories.detail: Caught fire at the turn - 9 across 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 17, wipe on hole 18 - the course corrects

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 21 on the front, 14 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 13 & 14 - club still in the bag

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Pleasantly Predictable
stories.detail: 7 two-pointers on holes 8-14 - the card is getting boring in the best way

stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 1-5 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.detail: 5 wipes in 18 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

comingLast.roast: somebody sit on him, the presso is not for another hour
9 above the cellar door with 5 to play - just keep scoring
the gap to Briggs is 11 - his short game is now a public interest matter
in on a cushion of 12 - refreshing the board between sips
his round is over, his sweating is not - 13 above the line
in the clubhouse 17 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
in the clubhouse, 17 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
18 clear and finished - now a full-time Briggs supporter
finished 18 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
safe-ish by 18 - the blue balls have come back from further
